faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a Marbella boat rental in 2033?
faq.a: Most yachts in our fleet have a maximum capacity of 12 passengers. This includes vessels like the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, and Ferretti 94. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (8m) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m) carry up to 5 passengers. Always check the specific boat's capacity before booking.

faq.q: Why are group size limits enforced on boat rentals?
faq.a: Group size limits are set by Spanish maritime law and insurance policies to ensure passenger safety. They consider factors like boat size, stability, life raft capacity, and emergency evacuation routes. Exceeding the limit can lead to fines, voided insurance, and safety risks.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat for more than 12 people in Marbella?
faq.a: Generally, no. Most recreational charters in Marbella are limited to 12 passengers maximum. For larger groups, you would need to charter multiple boats or consider a larger commercial vessel, which is not typically available for private hire through us.

faq.q: Do children count towards the group size limit?
faq.a: Yes, children of all ages count as passengers towards the maximum capacity. Safety regulations do not distinguish between adults and children. Always include infants and toddlers in your final headcount when booking.

faq.q: What is the capacity of the Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 (12.5m) has a maximum capacity of 9 passengers. It departs from Puerto Banús and is ideal for smaller groups. The charter includes a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks, priced from €749 for 2 hours.

faq.q: What is the capacity of the Mangusta 80?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (24m) accommodates up to 12 passengers. This includes both the white and grey variants. It departs from Puerto Banús and comes with a free jet ski for the first 4 hours. Minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719.

faq.q: What happens if my group exceeds the boat's capacity?
faq.a: If your group exceeds the boat's capacity, the skipper will not allow boarding. You may be asked to split into two separate charters or choose a larger vessel. To avoid disappointment, always confirm the exact number of guests when booking.

faq.q: Are there any boats that can accommodate 10-11 passengers?
faq.a: Yes, several boats in our fleet fit 10-11 passengers. The Azimut 39 holds 11, the Fairline Targa 12m holds 10, the Pershing 46 holds 10, and the Lagoon 380 holds 10. These are perfect for medium-sized groups.

data.body_html:
Planning a group trip to Marbella in 2033? Understanding Marbella boat rental group size limits 2033 is essential to avoid disappointment. Most yachts in our fleet cap at 12 passengers, but smaller vessels carry fewer. Whether you're celebrating a birthday or a corporate event, knowing the exact capacity ensures a smooth booking. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Here's everything you need to know about group sizes for your next charter.

Why Group Size Limits Matter

Group size limits on Marbella boat rentals are not arbitrary. They are enforced by Spanish maritime law and insurance requirements. These limits factor in the boat's stability, life raft capacity, and emergency evacuation routes. Exceeding the passenger limit can result in fines, voided insurance, and safety hazards. Always respect the stated maximum capacity for your chosen vessel.

Maximum Passenger Capacities by Boat

Our fleet offers a range of capacities to suit different group sizes. Here's a quick reference:

  • 5 passengers: Dubhe (8m), Mariah SX21 (6.4m)
  • 6 passengers: Red Tide (11m), Speedboat (7m)
  • 8 passengers: Bandido (11.5m)
  • 9 passengers: Astondoa 40 (12.5m)
  • 10 passengers: Fairline Targa 12m, Pershing 46, Lagoon 380
  • 11 passengers: Azimut 39 (12.5m)
  • 12 passengers: Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), Maiora 26m (26m)

All boats depart from Puerto Banús and include full amenities.

Small Groups (5-6 People)

For intimate gatherings, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are perfect. The Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) and Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) offer a bit more space. These boats are ideal for couples, families, or small friend groups exploring the Golden Mile or Cala del Faro. Pricing for these is on request via WhatsApp.

Medium Groups (8-11 People)

Groups of 8 to 11 will find excellent options. The Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) is a sporty choice. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are popular for their comfort and style. Both are Tier A boats, priced from €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and VAT. The Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), and Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) round out the options. These are great for cruising to Estepona or Cabo Cabopino.

Large Groups (12 People)

If you have a full group of 12, you're in luck. Our largest yachts all max out at 12 passengers. The Mangusta 80 (24m) — both white and grey variants — offers a free jet ski for the first 4 hours at €4,719. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), and Maiora 26m (26m) all provide ample space for parties, corporate events, or family outings. These yachts are perfect for visiting Sotogrande or anchoring at Cala Cortés. Pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

Booking Tips for 2033

To secure the best boat for your group size, book early — especially for peak summer months. Remember that children count as passengers. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. For Tier A boats, pricing is fixed; for others, contact us via WhatsApp for a quote. Departures are from Puerto Banús, with easy access to Marbella Marina and the Río Verde area.
